system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: **`CLAUDE.md`** — System prompt defining the agent's role, scope, and behavioral guidelines
system_prompt_style.note: CLAUDE.md is a fixed project file; Claude Code composes it with framework-injected tool lists, so arguably dynamically_composed. Paper: 'the prompt is kept task-agnostic'.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the agent read the task description .pdf file, fetched the design practice via the MCP document server, explored the working directory, and examined the previous analysis run and input files
env_context_strategy.note: Paraphrase risk: quote adapted from 'The agent read the task description .pdf file, fetched the design practice via the MCP document server, explored the working directory, and examined the previous analysis run and input files.'

observation_format.evidence_quote: Once the model proposes a tool call, the agentic framework executes it deterministically and appends the result to the context window.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Models are trained to recognize when a question requires external information and to generate a structured output (a function name and arguments) instead of a direct answer.

tool_count.note: Tool count not enumerated; Claude Code built-ins plus two MCP servers are configured in agent/.mcp.json but no list is given.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: **`.mcp.json`** — MCP server configuration for two servers: [folios](https://pypi.org/project/folios/) (design practice) and [internal-tool-docs-mcp](https://pypi.org/project/internal-tool-docs-mcp/) (tool API docs)
tool_schema_source.note: Host framework's own tool schemas not documented in repo.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The design practice was served via an Model Context Protocol (MCP) document server, giving the agent version-controlled access to the methodology.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Yao et al. [75] formalized this interleaving of reasoning traces and tool actions in the ReAct framework

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The engineer pointed the agent to the task description and requested a plan.
planning_granularity.note: Plan is produced as free text for engineer approval; no stored plan object described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the agentic application, the configured agentic framework that defines a specific LLM, system prompt, and tool connections for a given engineering context

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: An LLM agent runs tools in a loop to achieve a goal
delegation_mechanism.note: No delegation to other agents described anywhere in paper or repo.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Engineers review plans and sign off on outputs; autonomy is limited to orchestration, not engineering judgment
human_in_loop.note: Engineer 1 approved the plan; engineers can also stop execution mid-run.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the agentic framework executes it deterministically and appends the result to the context window

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: instead, they are retrieved at run time from knowledge resources or disclosed progressively via skills [89]
long_term_memory.note: Design-practice documents served via folios MCP persist across runs; skills mentioned as the mechanism in the approach.

self_verification.evidence_quote: a deterministic check against reference values, a human expert review, or an LLM-as-a-judge assessment
self_verification.note: Applies to the evaluation pipeline (evaluation/evaluator.py, Pydantic AI judge), not to in-run agent self-checking.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: DUCTILE adopts the passˆk metric [52], defined as whether the agent correctly performs the same task in k independent repetitions.
retry_policy.note: Repetitions are independent evaluation runs, not retries after failure.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The decision to finish the iteration is made by the LLM based on its training behaviors and the content of the context window.
termination_condition.note: Engineer can also interrupt; no step/cost caps described.

cost_controls.note: Telemetry captures token/cost but no limiting mechanism is described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Claude Code operates within the engineer’s existing integrated development environment (IDE) and file system.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The engineer can inspect every file the agent reads or writes
filesystem_access.note: Repo ships agent/.claudeignore, which excludes paths; coded relative to the host filesystem boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: All MCP servers and the loads tool are fetched automatically via `uvx` and script frontmatter; no manual installation is required.
network_policy.note: No network restriction described; package fetching implies open egress.

permission_model.evidence_quote: When a roadblock in the execution plan stops the model from getting closer to the goal (e.g., permission access, and tool failure)
permission_model.note: Host framework's permission prompts not documented in the pinned repo; coded from absence of any configured policy.

tracing.evidence_quote: Messages, tool calls, and tool results at minimum shall be sent for recording to an observability platform via standard payloads (e.g., OpenTeleme-try).
tracing.note: Implemented via Pydantic Logfire in evaluation/evaluator.py; session transcripts stored as JSONL.

replayability.evidence_quote: Model, prompt, tool versions, and inputs must be pinned and logged; runs are reproducible or cause-attributable despite stochastic LLM steps

target_domain.evidence_quote: an approach for developing, executing, and evaluating LLM-based agentic automation of engineering analysis tasks
target_domain.note: Domain is mechanical/aerospace engineering analysis orchestration; closest value is `other`.

open_source.evidence_quote: This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details.

model_agnostic.note: Agentic application built on Claude Code with Anthropic models; the approach itself is framework-agnostic.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: This repository contains the implementation, evaluation pipeline, and session transcripts for the DUCTILE approach to agentic LLM orchestration of engineering analysis

first_release_date.note: Basis: date of the pinned tag v1.1; no earlier tag given in evidence.

pinned_version.note: Only the short hash is given in the evidence.
